copy.headline: North Texas election leaves city council in legal quagmire after recalled mayor
copy.caption: North Texas election leaves city council in legal quagmire after recalled mayor, city council members break quorum. Citizens of Fate have told WFAA they intend to sue to have a judge find a path forward as legal options are not clear after the broken quorum.

story.title: North Texas election leaves city council in legal quagmire after recalled mayor, city council members break quorum
story.summary: Citizens of Fate have told WFAA they intend to sue to have a judge find a path forward as legal options are not clear after the broken quorum.
